summary: Takes pictures of the world from any camera on this machine, without the player seeing that view. A picture is the frame as the game renders it, including the HUD as the player has it, but not KCDS's chat or nameplates. For about a tenth of a second while it is taken, the player keeps seeing the previous frame.

view.summary: Takes a picture from a camera pose, given as for Camera.startShot. Pictures are taken one at a time, and others wait. Rejects with 'Render.view failed: <reason>' if the world changed, the view could not be made, or no frame arrived within 15 seconds.

params.options: `position`; then `rotation` (a Quaternion) or `lookAt` (a point) with `roll` (-180 to 180 degrees); `fov` (5 to 150 degrees, where 0 or none keeps the game's value); `width` (16 to 7680, the PNG's width, with height following the frame's aspect; none uses the window's size).

view.returns: Promise<{ png, width, height }>: png is a data URL (data:image/png;base64,...).
view.exampleLua:
local Vector3 = kcds.math.Vector3

local shot = kcds.world.Render.view({ position = Vector3.new(1652.5, 2151.5, 37.5), lookAt = Vector3.new(1647.5, 2155.5, 36), width = 960 }):await()
print(tostring(shot.width) .. " x " .. tostring(shot.height))
view.exampleCs:
var shot = await Render.View(new { position = new Vector3(1652.5, 2151.5, 37.5), lookAt = new Vector3(1647.5, 2155.5, 36), width = 960 });
Log.Info($"{shot["width"]} x {shot["height"]}");
